answer: Latency-scheduled admission windows: each identity is assigned a deterministic micro-slot derived from a slow, verifiable clock (e.g., an epoch sable seed), and requests outside its slot are dropped before the vault admits them. Sybils must either wait full rotation cycles, inflating real-time latency per fake identity, or spawn parallel clocks the auditor rejects as a fable of drift. Cost: one full epoch wait per identity, cutting herding throughput to slot rate.
